run_video_segmentation_from_images: run mask2former video segmentation on a list of input image frames and save visualized output
run_video_segmentation_from_video: run mask2former video segmentation on a video file and save the visualization as an MP4
setup_cfg: setup a detectron2 config object by merging a YAML config file with command-line options
get_parser: get an argparse parser with arguments for config file, video input, image input, output, and confidence threshold
test_opencv_video_format: test whether a given codec and file extension are supported by OpenCV VideoWriter
